recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not introduce a new Condition record-status element for this historical duplicate unless Patient Care opens a new issue to revisit the current placement of entered-in-error in verificationStatus.
issue_request: FHIR-7864 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 Condition and asked that Condition.clinicalStatus not combine record status such as entered-in-error with confirmation status such as working, confirmed, or refuted; its resolution treated it as a duplicate of FHIR-7581.
initial_application: FHIR-7581 resolved the duplicate family by splitting Condition.clinicalStatus into clinicalStatus and verificationStatus and adding a usage note about stage and clinicalStatus interdependencies. Git commit 0a6643ad139240e0f578cbe596e007d6c516df3e explicitly applied the family with message 'Split Condition.status {#7581} {#7617} {#7864}'.
additional_context: Current Condition source is active in source/fhir.ini and defines clinicalStatus separately from verificationStatus, with separate condition-clinical and condition-ver-status value-set bindings. Later published issues FHIR-14821, FHIR-22973, and FHIR-29409 refined the current entered-in-error, invariant, unknown-code, and cardinality behavior, so current wording need not match the 2015 resolution literally. A stale List hyperlink found during this investigation was fixed separately under FHIR-19730.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit for FHIR-7864 because no seed-specific source change is needed after considering the duplicate target, implementation commit, current source, and later decisions.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-7864 was resolved as per FHIR-7581, which formally split Condition status into clinicalStatus and verificationStatus.
The same implementation commit also mentioned FHIR-7617, which dropped the old 'working' status in favor of provisional.
Later published decision about clinicalStatus presence when verificationStatus is entered-in-error.
Later published invariant issue, with comments noting FHIR-29409 largely made the specific requested change irrelevant.
Later published decision made clinicalStatus 1..1, added unknown guidance, and superseded older invariant details.
Related List narrative issue discovered during status-split checking and fixed in a separate source commit.
